# Mail app using wrong alias when replying to emails
I have three email aliases on my imap account. We'll call themlogin@example.com,me@example.com, andotherme@example.com.
login is only used as the login username. I never use it.
me is set as the default address
When I send an email from scratch, the mail app selectsme@example.comas the from address. That's good. But when I reply to an email that was received tome@example.com, the mail app selectsotherme@example.comas the from address, not the default, and not the address that the email I am replying to was received with.
Is this just me? iOS 14.5.1

I found a solution: I deleted all my aliases (me@example.com, otherme@example.com) from the mail app's account settings, and exited to save the settings.
I then added my desired default (me@example.com) and set it as the default, and exited to save the settings. At this point I confirmed that it was working as desired.
